pages.text: Grinds ores and raw ores into $(l)2 dusts$() (10% chance of a third) and ingots into 1 dust. Smelt the dusts into ingots. It also crushes cobblestone, gravel, bones, blaze rods, wool, glowstone and more.
Uses 16 FE/t and has a battery slot. Hoppers insert from any side and take the results out. Datapacks can add recipes of type $(item)redcircuit:macerating$().
